content.text: Note: SSRIs + venlafaxine relative potency = mg ≈ fluoxetine 40 mg/day (Hayasaka 2015; *citalopram = clinical SSRI eq)    -    other SNRIs have ⍉ RCT fluoxetine-eq -> shown by SERT:NET selectivity (5HT-pref -> NE-pref):    -    venlafaxine ~30:1 (most serotonergic) > desvenlafaxine > duloxetine ~10:1 > milnacipran ~2:1 NE > levomilnacipran (most NE-selective; 17× venlafaxine, 27× duloxetine at NET)
